as_told.title: Mussolini asks Hitler about the Magenta craft

plain: An unknown craft, called the Magenta object, is said to have crashed in Italy in 1933, and Benito Mussolini supposedly went to Adolf Hitler afterwards and asked, "Is this yours?", which led to a partnership between the two over it. Michels tells this himself on two episodes, calling it rumor and never naming a source. If true, it would mean a crashed craft was in fascist hands years before the Second World War.
